tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Cool off-white paper, never warm. Gets a faint fibre texture in the live background.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text, hairlines at full strength, star dots. Text on paper.

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text, mono labels, captions on paper.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines: orbit rings, constellation lines, drawn line art. Non-text.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Guides, dashed orbits, frame insets, progress rail. Non-text.

tokens.name: pigment-a
tokens.usage: Watercolor pigment one, lilac. Arrives first. Washes and line accents only, never behind body text at full strength.

tokens.name: pigment-b
tokens.usage: Watercolor pigment two, blue. Arrives later in the journey. Washes and line accents only.

tokens.name: pigment-c
tokens.usage: Watercolor teal. Footer only, a reward for reaching the end of a page.

tokens.name: pigment-d
tokens.usage: Watercolor orchid. Footer only.

tokens.name: box-black
tokens.usage: Default box behind the last name, the nav hover and current-page box, project title hovers, and the Games category colour. White text on it.

tokens.name: box-blue
tokens.usage: Colour box option, and the Classes category colour (orbit, legend, panel tag). White text on it.

tokens.name: box-lilac
tokens.usage: Default box behind the kicker, and the AI / ML category colour. White text on it.

tokens.name: box-ink
tokens.usage: Colour box option. White text on it.

tokens.name: box-teal
tokens.usage: Colour box option, and the Community tools category colour. White text on it.

tokens.name: box-indigo
tokens.usage: Colour box option. White text on it.

tokens.name: on-box
tokens.usage: Text on any colour box.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Frosted panel fill for an opened case, over watercolor. Text on it uses ink.

tokens.name: games-line
tokens.usage: The Games orbit line, so the black category stays visible in dark mode. Non-text.

styles.name: name-xl
styles.usage: The name on arrival. Uppercase, very wide tracking. Scales with the viewport (8.2vw).

styles.name: statement
styles.usage: A single large statement, like the mission line.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text. Light weight, never below 300.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: HUD labels, nav, metadata, numbers. Always uppercase and tracked.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside labels.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between related lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Side gutter and panel padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: HUD bar height, gaps between groups.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Chapter top and bottom insets.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything rectangular: colour boxes, panels, frames. No rounded boxes.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Only true circles: orbit rings, star dots, progress dots, marbles.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every drawn line. Never thicker than 1.4px.
